spec: R-14 native-review queue — Doc 11 machine-authored Amharic (opened S11 step 8; GROWN at the S11 close with the FULL org.* + routing.* trees per the step-14 join). Customer-facing band phrases first (SEC-05 vocabulary); the destructive tier is flagged per entry.

entries.am: ስለመልእክትዎ እናመሰግናለን። የቡድናችን አባል በቅርቡ ያነጋግርዎታል — :queue_wait።
entries.en: Thanks for your message. A member of our team will be with you shortly — :queue_wait.

entries.am: ወረፋው ስለተሰረዘ ወደ የክፍሉ ነባሪ ወረፋ ተዛውሯል
entries.en: Moved to the department default queue — its queue was deleted

entries.am: የተመደበው ወኪል ግንኙነት ስላጣ ወደ ወረፋው ተመልሷል
entries.en: Returned to the queue — the assigned agent lost connection

entries.am: መቀበልን ያቆማል፤ ያሉ ትኬቶች በተለመደው ይጠናቀቃሉ።
entries.en: Stops intake; existing tickets drain normally.

entries.am: መጀመሪያ እያንዳንዱ ወረፋ፣ ትኬትና ሕግ ማጣቀሻ እንደገና መመደብ አለበት። አዋቂውን ይከፍታል።
entries.en: Requires every queue, ticket and rule reference to be reassigned first. Opens the wizard.

entries.am: ▲ :name ወረፋ የለውም — መቀበያ ወደ ምንም ይወድቃል
entries.en: ▲ :name has no queues — intake falls to nothing

entries.am: ወደዚህ ክፍል የሚመራ ማንኛውም ትኬት የሚጠብቅበት ቦታና የሚደርሰው ሰው የለም። ወረፋ ይፍጠሩ ወይም የክፍሉን ነባሪ ወደ ሌላ ወረፋ ያመልክቱ።
entries.en: Any ticket routed to this department has nowhere to wait and no one to reach. Create a queue, or point the department's default at another queue.

entries.am: :name በዚህ ቡድን ውስጥ ነው ግን ወደ :department መዳረሻ የለውም።
entries.en: :name is in this team but has no access to :department.

entries.am: ወደ :team የሚመሩ የ:department ትኬቶች ያልፉታል፤ ስለዚህ ቡድኑ ከሚመስለው ያንሳል።
entries.en: :department tickets routed to :team will skip them, so the team is effectively smaller than it looks.

entries.am: የRG ወረፋ ልዩ ነው። መስመር እዚህ ይቆማል — ማንም ትኬት ከኃላፊነት ጨዋታ ውጭ አይመራም። ምትክ የRG ዒላማ ሳይሰየም ሊሰረዝ አይችልም።
entries.en: The RG queue is special. Routing stops here — nothing re-routes a ticket out of Responsible Gaming. It cannot be deleted without naming a replacement RG target first.
Next four tickets will go to

entries.am: መጀመሪያ ትንሹ ክፍት ትኬት ያለው፤ እኩል ከሆኑ ከረጅም ጊዜ በፊት የተመደበው፣ ከዚያ በመለያ ቅደም። መሠረቱ አይንቀሳቀስም።
entries.en: Least open tickets first; ties go to whoever was assigned longest ago, then by user id. The floor never moves.

entries.am: ትኬቱ ይጠብቃል እና የSLA ማንቂያ ያነሳል። የተሳሳተ-ቋንቋ መልስ ከዘገየ መልስ የከፋ በሆነበት ተገቢ ነው።
entries.en: The ticket waits and raises an SLA-aware alert. Right where a wrong-language reply is worse than a slow one.

entries.am: የቋንቋ መስፈርቱ ይወርዳል፤ በትንሽ ጫና ያለው ወኪል ይወስዳል።
entries.en: The language requirement drops and the least-loaded agent takes it.
:count tickets are holding for a match right now.

entries.am: ከ30 ደቂቃ ጥበቃ በኋላ ማንኛውም ትኬት ወረፋውን ይዘላል። ሁልጊዜ በርቷል።
entries.en: After 30 min waiting, any ticket jumps the line. Always on.

entries.am: :members አባላት · :online በመስመር ላይ · :free ክፍት ቦታ ያላቸው:skill። :waiting ትኬቶች እየጠበቁ ናቸው።
entries.en: :members members · :online online · :free with a free slot:skill. :waiting tickets are holding.
The wait estimate, as the customer will read it

entries.am: ባንዶች ብቻ። ደንበኛ ከፊቱ ስንት ሰው እንዳለ ወይም ስንት ወኪሎች በመስመር ላይ እንዳሉ በጭራሽ አይነገረውም — ያ የወረፋ መረጃ ነው፣ ውስጥም ይቆያል።
entries.en: Bands only. A customer is never told how many people are ahead of them or how many agents are online — that is queue intelligence, and it stays inside.

entries.am: አዲስ ትኬቶች መምጣት ያቆማሉ። እዚህ ያሉት :count ባሉበት ይቆያሉ፣ ወኪሎችም መስራታቸውን ይቀጥላሉ። በማንኛውም ጊዜ መልሰው ማብራት ይችላሉ።
entries.en: New tickets stop arriving. The :count already here stay exactly where they are, and agents keep working them. You can turn it back on any time.

entries.am: እነዚህ ሕጎች ወደ ክፍሉ ነባሪ ይወርዳሉ፦
entries.en: These rules fall to the department default:

entries.am: ቋሚ ነው። እያንዳንዱ ትኬት ወደ ሌላ መዛወር፣ እያንዳንዱ ማጣቀሻም መቀየር አለበት — አዋቂው መንገዱን ያሳይዎታል።
entries.en: Permanent. Every ticket has to be moved somewhere and every reference repointed first — the wizard walks you through it.

entries.am: በሂደት ላይ · ይህን መስኮት መዝጋት ይችላሉ
entries.en: in progress · you can close this window

entries.am: አምስት ሥርዓቶችን መርምረናል። ከመወገዱ በፊት ከዚህ በታች ያለው ሁሉ መፈታት አለበት።
entries.en: We checked five systems. Everything below has to be resolved before this can go.

entries.am: ያላየናቸው ማጣቀሻዎች ሊኖሩ ይችላሉ። ያልተሳካውን ምርመራ እንደገና ይሞክሩ፣ ወይም ባልተሟላ ዝርዝር ይቀጥሉ — የተዘለለው ሁሉ ሲወገድ ይሰበራል።
entries.en: There may be references we could not see. Retry the failed check, or continue with a partial list — anything missed will break when this goes.

entries.am: ተመዳቢያቸውን፣ ቅድሚያቸውንና የSLA ሰዓታቸውን ይዘው ይቆያሉ። የሚቀየረው ወረፋው ብቻ ነው።
entries.en: They keep their assignee, priority and SLA clock. Only the queue changes.

entries.am: ይህ ኃላፊነት የተሞላበት ጨዋታ ወረፋ ነው።
መስመሩ ሁልጊዜ አንዱን ማግኘት መቻል አለበት፤ ስለዚህ ይህ ክፍል ከመሄዱ በፊት ያን ሚና የሚወስደውን ወረፋ መሰየም አለብዎት።
entries.en: Routing must always be able to reach one, so you have to name which queue takes that role before this department can go.
Cannot continue until the RG queue is named

entries.am: ይህ ወረፋ የክፍሉ ነባሪ ነው። መጀመሪያ ክፍሉን ወደ ሌላ ነባሪ ወረፋ ያመልክቱ።
entries.en: This queue is the department default. Point the department at another default queue first.

entries.am: :count ትኬቶች ወደ :name ይዛወራሉ። ይህ በጥቅሎች ይሠራል።
entries.en: :count tickets move to :name. This runs in batches.

entries.am: :count ራስ-ሰር ደንቦች ይጠፋሉ — እስኪጻፉ ድረስ መስራት ያቆማሉ።
entries.en: :count automation rules are switched off — they stop working until someone rewrites them.

entries.am: :count የSLA ፖሊሲዎች፣ ቦቶችና የተቀመጡ እይታዎች ይቀየራሉ።
entries.en: :count SLA policies, bots and saved views repoint.

entries.am: ወረፋው ይሰረዛል። የቁጥር ታሪኩና የኦዲት መዝገቡ ይቆያሉ።
entries.en: The queue is deleted. Its number history and audit trail stay.

entries.am: ክፍሉና ወረፋዎቹ ይሰረዛሉ። የቁጥር ታሪክና የኦዲት መዝገብ ይቆያሉ።
entries.en: The department and its queues are deleted. Number history and audit trail stay.
That does not match. Type :phrase exactly.

entries.am: ሲወስኑ የትኬት ቁጥሩ ተቀይሯል — አሁን :phrase ነው። ቁጥሮቹን አይተው እንደገና ይተይቡ።
entries.en: The ticket count changed while you were deciding — it is now :phrase. Check the numbers and type again.
SLA policies, bots and views repointed
We will let you know when it finishes

entries.am: ቆሟል፦ የአስኪያጁ መለያ የለም። ሌላ ምንም አልተዛወረም።
entries.en: Stopped: the operator account is gone. Nothing else was moved.

entries.am: ቆሟል፦ አስኪያጁ በሂደቱ መካከል ፈቃድ አጥቷል። ሌላ ምንም አልተዛወረም።
entries.en: Stopped: the operator lost permission mid-run. Nothing else was moved.
▲ Your changes to :name were not saved

entries.am: እርስዎ በማረም ላይ ሳሉ ሌላ ሰው ይህን ቀይሯል። ምንም አልተጻፈም — የእነሱን ስሪት ለማየት እንደገና ይጫኑ፣ ወይም የእርስዎን ይዘው በላዩ ይቀምጡ።
entries.en: Someone else changed this while you were editing. Nothing has been overwritten — reload to see their version, or keep yours and save over it.
Department set explicitly by the caller.
AI suggestion applied — auto-accept is on.

entries.am: የAI አስተያየት አልተተገበረም (ራስ-ተቀባይ ጠፍቷል) — ለግምገማ ተመልክቷል።
entries.en: AI suggestion NOT applied (auto-accept off) — flagged for review.

entries.am: ከግንኙነቱ የመስመር መለያ የመጣ የውይይት ነባሪ።
entries.en: Conversation default from the connection routing tag.

entries.am: የግንኙነቱ መለያ ክፍል አላገኘም — ወደ ቀጣዩ ምንጭ።
entries.en: The connection tag matched no department — next source.

entries.am: የተከራይ ነባሪ ክፍል (የAI አስተያየቱ ለግምገማ ተመልክቶ ይቆያል)።
entries.en: Tenant default department (the AI suggestion stays flagged for review).
Queue set explicitly by the caller.
A rule matched the routing tag.

entries.am: የኃላፊነት ጨዋታ መግቢያ — ወደ RG ወረፋ ተገድዷል። ይህ መስመር የመጨረሻ ነው።
entries.en: Responsible-gambling intake — FORCED to the RG queue. This routing is final.

entries.am: የኃላፊነት ጨዋታ መግቢያ፣ ግን RG ወረፋ የለም — የተፈታው ወረፋ ይቆያል።
entries.en: Responsible-gambling intake, but no RG queue exists — the resolved queue stands.

entries.am: ከ:cap ደቂቃ ገደቡ በላይ ጠብቋል — ወደ ወረፋው ራስ ከፍ ተደርጓል፣ ሁሉንም ማበልጸጊያ ይበልጣል።
entries.en: Waited past the :cap-minute cap — promoted to the head of the queue, every boost outranked.

entries.am: ነጻ ቦታ ያለው ብቁ ወኪል በመስመር ላይ የለም።
entries.en: No eligible agent online with a free slot.

entries.am: ትንሽ ክፍት ትኬት ያለው ቀዳሚ (:load ክፍት)
በተጠቃሚ መለያ ቅደም ተከተል የመጀመሪያው ብቁ
የክህሎት ማዛመድ፦ :language — በመስመር ላይ የለም፤ ከገደቡ በላይ ስለጠበቀ የቋንቋ መስፈርቱ ተትቷል
entries.en: skill match: :language — nobody online with it; waited past the cap, so the language requirement dropped

entries.am: የክህሎት ማዛመድ፦ :language — በመስመር ላይ የለም፤ የቅርብ-ክህሎት አማራጭ፣ የቋንቋ መስፈርቱ ተትቷል
entries.en: skill match: :language — nobody online with it; nearest-skill fallback, language requirement dropped

entries.am: የክህሎት ማዛመድ፦ :language — :online በመስመር ላይ፣ ክህሎቱ ያለው 0 → የሚመጥን ወኪል በመጠበቅ ላይ
entries.en: skill match: :language — :online online, 0 with the skill → holding for a matching agent

entries.am: በመፈጸሚያው ቅጽበት አቅም ሞልቷል — ወደ ቀጣዩ እጩ።
entries.en: At capacity at the moment of commit — next candidate.
Claimed by a person first — routing yields.

entries.am: እጩው ይህን ትኬት መድረስ አይችልም — ወደ ቀጣዩ እጩ።
entries.en: The candidate cannot reach this ticket — next candidate.

entries.am: በወረፋ በመጠበቅ ላይ — በሚቀጥለው የመገኘት ክስተት እንደገና ይገመገማል።
